thread:
leo: Heads-up: coordinated deploy tonight 02:00 UTC. API v2.3 + runtime kernel toggle. Need router header-split and console prefetch pin before canary. DeployBot scheduled canary at 02:10.
anya: Copy. I'll pin console to 2.3-rc and add a conservative cache fallback flag.
carmen: Router: can add a temporary route for /internal-prefetch scoped to canary pool. Will add header-check to avoid accidental pinning. ETA ~7m.
leo: Plan: canary 5% (02:10-02:20), observe 10m, then 25% at 02:30. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 600ms sustained 5m.
devbot: Canary starting now. Health checks on: 5xx rate, p95 latency, route-error-rate.
sylvie: Runtime note: kernel batch-mode flip + KV eviction tuning. Expect warmup latency for short seqs; we'll enable batch-ramp to smooth.
opsbot: Preflight: certs ok, feature-flag runtime:new_kernels=false default, DB no-op.
leo: After canary warmup, console will call prefetch: POST /internal/prefetch?scope=canary with OP token. Use X-Test-Canary header so router can route correctly.
anya: Queuing prefetch job. Need router rule in place first.
carmen: Rule queued and applied: /internal-prefetch -> canary, header X-Test-Canary required, TTL 10m.
devbot: Canary update (02:15): p95 -> 700ms, 2/50 checks failing, no 5xx. Canary set to HOLD.
leo: Hold. Likely warmup noise but enable console fallback to prevent user impact. No rollback yet.
anya: Turning on console fallback flag now; UI will use cached values on prefetch miss. Adding note in release notes.
sylvie: After enabling slower batch-ramp, canary p95 dropped to 480ms. Emitting metric runtime.kv.prefetch_miss; console will tag X-KV-Fallback when fallback used.
devbot: Canary recovered. Recommendation: advance to 25% at 02:30.
leo: Decision: resume rollout to 25%, extend monitoring window to 3h post-rollout. Add changelog entry: "Known warmup latency with new runtime kernel; mitigations: console prefetch + fallback, batch-ramp."
anya: Will publish ops how-to for private deploys (prefetch endpoint + X-KV-Fallback semantics).
carmen: Temporary router rule removed after prefetch window; no residual pinning.
devbot: Rollout to 25% started. Full rollout targeted 03:00 if stable.
leo: If thresholds breach, open #incidents and tag eng-sre immediately. Postmortem should include kernel toggle timeline, prefetch metrics, fallback events.
opsbot: Telemetry retained: kv.prefetch_miss and X-KV-Fallback traces for 72h.
leo: Thanks team. Stand down unless alerts fire.
